meta.title: Recharged Yellow Field Guide
meta.journeyIntro: Kanto in story order. Each stop shows its wild Pokémon, the items found there and its big battles, all read from the game itself.
meta.journeyNote: Recharged Yellow has no official guide, so everything here was read straight from the game (version 1.9.7). The order follows the usual Kanto route; your exact path may vary.
meta.footer: Unofficial guide built from Pokémon Recharged Yellow 1.9.7's own data (read from the ROM; table locations from PokeDaisy). Recharged Yellow is made by Jaizu.

placeholders.jFilter: Find a stop (Pewter, Mt. Moon, Safari…)

meta.trainersIntro: Gym Leaders, the Elite Four, the Champion, your rival and Team Rocket, with full teams. Recharged Yellow has a Hard difficulty: each boss's Hard team has its own button.
meta.itemsIntro: Where items are found: item balls, hidden items and gifts on each map, and what the Poké Marts sell. Read from the game's map scripts, so a few one-off events may be missing.
meta.moreIntro: Gift and legendary Pokémon, and the type chart (Recharged Yellow keeps Gen 3's types: no Fairy).

forms.name: Bulbasaur
forms.dexText: It can go for days without eating a single morsel. In the bulb on its back, it stores energy.

forms.name: Ivysaur
forms.dexText: The bulb on its back grows by drawing energy. It gives off an aroma when it is ready to bloom.

forms.name: Venusaur
forms.dexText: The flower on its back catches the sun's rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.

forms.name: Charmander
forms.dexText: The flame at the tip of its tail makes a sound as it burns. You can only hear it in quiet places.

forms.name: Charmeleon
forms.dexText: Tough fights could excite this Pokémon. When excited, it may blow out bluish- white flames.

forms.name: Charizard
forms.dexText: When expelling a blast of super hot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

forms.name: Squirtle
forms.dexText: Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.

forms.name: Wartortle
forms.dexText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

forms.name: Blastoise
forms.dexText: Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.

forms.name: Caterpie
forms.dexText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

forms.name: Metapod
forms.dexText: This Pokémon is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

forms.name: Butterfree
forms.dexText: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

forms.name: Weedle
forms.dexText: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp stinger on its head that injects poison.

forms.name: Kakuna
forms.dexText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

forms.name: Beedrill
forms.dexText: It flies at high speed and attacks using the large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

forms.name: Pidgey
forms.dexText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

forms.name: Pidgeotto
forms.dexText: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

forms.name: Pidgeot
forms.dexText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

forms.name: Rattata
forms.dexText: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

forms.name: Raticate
forms.dexText: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

forms.name: Spearow
forms.dexText: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

forms.name: Fearow
forms.dexText: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

forms.name: Ekans
forms.dexText: Moving silently and stealthily, it eats the eggs of birds, such as Pidgey and Spearow, whole.

forms.name: Arbok
forms.dexText: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

forms.name: Pikachu
forms.dexText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

forms.name: Raichu
forms.dexText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

forms.name: Sandshrew
forms.dexText: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for prey.

forms.name: Sandslash
forms.dexText: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

forms.name: Nidoran♀
forms.dexText: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

forms.name: Nidorina
forms.dexText: The female's horns develop slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

forms.name: Nidoqueen
forms.dexText: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

forms.name: Nidoran♂
forms.dexText: It stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

forms.name: Nidorino
forms.dexText: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

forms.name: Nidoking
forms.dexText: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.

forms.name: Clefairy
forms.dexText: With its magical and cute appeal, it has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

forms.name: Clefable
forms.dexText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

forms.name: Vulpix
forms.dexText: When it is born, it has just one snow- white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

forms.name: Ninetales
forms.dexText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

forms.name: Jigglypuff
forms.dexText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

forms.name: Wigglytuff
forms.dexText: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

forms.name: Zubat
forms.dexText: It forms colonies in perpetually dark places and uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

forms.name: Golbat
forms.dexText: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

forms.name: Oddish
forms.dexText: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

forms.name: Gloom
forms.dexText: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

forms.name: Vileplume
forms.dexText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

forms.name: Paras
forms.dexText: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

forms.name: Parasect
forms.dexText: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

forms.name: Venonat
forms.dexText: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

forms.name: Venomoth
forms.dexText: The dustlike scales covering its wings are color-coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

forms.name: Diglett
forms.dexText: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

forms.name: Dugtrio
forms.dexText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

forms.name: Meowth
forms.dexText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

forms.name: Persian
forms.dexText: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

forms.name: Psyduck
forms.dexText: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokémon will use psychokinetic powers.

forms.name: Golduck
forms.dexText: Often seen swimming elegantly by lakeshores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster Kappa.

forms.name: Mankey
forms.dexText: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

forms.name: Primeape
forms.dexText: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it catches up.

forms.name: Growlithe
forms.dexText: It is very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

forms.name: Arcanine
forms.dexText: A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

forms.name: Poliwag
forms.dexText: Its newly grown legs prevent it from walking well. It appears to prefer swimming over walking.

forms.name: Poliwhirl
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding King's Rock
forms.dexText: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.

forms.name: Poliwrath
forms.dexText: A swimmer adept at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

forms.name: Abra
forms.dexText: Using its ability to read minds, it will sense impending danger and Teleport to safety.

forms.name: Kadabra
forms.dexText: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close.

forms.name: Alakazam
forms.dexText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its IQ (intelligence quotient) is said to be around 5,000.

forms.name: Machop
forms.dexText: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

forms.name: Machoke
forms.dexText: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

forms.name: Machamp
forms.dexText: Its superpowerful punches are said to knock the victim flying clear over the horizon.

forms.name: Bellsprout
forms.dexText: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It appears to use its root feet to replenish moisture.

forms.name: Weepinbell
forms.dexText: It spits out PoisonPowder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

forms.name: Victreebel
forms.dexText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

forms.name: Tentacool
forms.dexText: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.

forms.name: Tentacruel
forms.dexText: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

forms.name: Geodude
forms.dexText: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

forms.name: Graveler
forms.dexText: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

forms.name: Golem
forms.dexText: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without taking damage.

forms.name: Ponyta
forms.dexText: Its hooves are ten times harder than diamond. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

forms.name: Rapidash
forms.dexText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

forms.name: Slowpoke
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding King's Rock
forms.dexText: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

forms.name: Slowbro
forms.dexText: The Shellder that latches onto Slowpoke's tail is said to feed on the host's leftover scraps.

forms.name: Magnemite
forms.dexText: Uses antigravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses Thunder Wave and similar moves.

forms.name: Magneton
forms.dexText: Formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

forms.name: Farfetch'd
forms.dexText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

forms.name: Doduo
forms.dexText: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

forms.name: Dodrio
forms.dexText: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head is said to stay awake.

forms.name: Seel
forms.dexText: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick icebergs.

forms.name: Dewgong
forms.dexText: It stores thermal energy in the body. It swims at a steady eight knots even in intensely cold waters.

forms.name: Grimer
forms.dexText: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

forms.name: Muk
forms.dexText: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

forms.name: Shellder
forms.dexText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

forms.name: Cloyster
forms.dexText: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never beenseen.

forms.name: Gastly
forms.dexText: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

forms.name: Haunter
forms.dexText: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

forms.name: Gengar
forms.dexText: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

forms.name: Onix
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding Metal Coat
forms.dexText: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to black-colored diamonds.

forms.name: Drowzee
forms.dexText: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

forms.name: Hypno
forms.dexText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

forms.name: Krabby
forms.dexText: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

forms.name: Kingler
forms.dexText: The large pincer has 10,000-horsepower crushing force. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

forms.name: Voltorb
forms.dexText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

forms.name: Electrode
forms.dexText: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

forms.name: Exeggcute
forms.dexText: It is often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

forms.name: Exeggutor
forms.dexText: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

forms.name: Cubone
forms.dexText: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

forms.name: Marowak
forms.dexText: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

forms.name: Hitmonlee
forms.dexText: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra-long, loping strides.

forms.name: Hitmonchan
forms.dexText: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

forms.name: Lickitung
forms.dexText: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

forms.name: Koffing
forms.dexText: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

forms.name: Weezing
forms.dexText: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two Koffing can fuse into a Weezing over many years.

forms.name: Rhyhorn
forms.dexText: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. Its Tackle can knock a semitrailer flying.

forms.name: Rhydon
forms.dexText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

forms.name: Chansey
forms.dexText: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch one.

forms.name: Tangela
forms.dexText: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. The vines sway as it walks.

forms.name: Kangaskhan
forms.dexText: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is three years old.

forms.name: Horsea
forms.dexText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

forms.name: Seadra
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding Dragon Scale
forms.dexText: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

forms.name: Goldeen
forms.dexText: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of “The Water Queen.”

forms.name: Seaking
forms.dexText: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

forms.name: Staryu
forms.dexText: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

forms.name: Starmie
forms.dexText: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

forms.name: Mr. Mime
forms.dexText: If interrupted while it is miming, it will suddenly DoubleSlap the offender with its broad hands.

forms.name: Scyther
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding Metal Coat
forms.dexText: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of itself.

forms.name: Jynx
forms.dexText: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

forms.name: Electabuzz
forms.dexText: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

forms.name: Magmar
forms.dexText: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly amidst flames.

forms.name: Pinsir
forms.dexText: If it fails to crush the foe in its pincers, it will swing around and toss the opponent.

forms.name: Tauros
forms.dexText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

forms.name: Magikarp
forms.dexText: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

forms.name: Gyarados
forms.dexText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

forms.name: Lapras
forms.dexText: A Pokémon that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people on its back.

forms.name: Ditto
forms.dexText: Capable of copying an opponent's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

forms.name: Eevee
forms.dexText: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element Stones.

forms.name: Vaporeon
forms.dexText: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

forms.name: Jolteon
forms.dexText: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

forms.name: Flareon
forms.dexText: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature can soar to over 1,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

forms.name: Porygon
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding Up-Grade
forms.dexText: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. It is capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

forms.name: Omanyte
forms.dexText: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically regenerated from fossils.

forms.name: Omastar
forms.dexText: Despite having strong fangs and tentacles, it went extinct when its heavy shell made it unable to catch prey.

forms.name: Kabuto
forms.dexText: A Pokémon that was regenerated from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor long ago.

forms.name: Kabutops
forms.dexText: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains their fluids.

forms.name: Aerodactyl
forms.dexText: A ferocious, prehistoric Pokémon that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated, sawlike fangs.

forms.name: Snorlax
forms.dexText: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

forms.name: Articuno
forms.dexText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

forms.name: Zapdos
forms.dexText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

forms.name: Moltres
forms.dexText: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

forms.name: Dratini
forms.dexText: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

forms.name: Dragonair
forms.dexText: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. It is said to have the ability to change the weather.

forms.name: Dragonite
forms.dexText: Only a very few people ever see this Pokémon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

forms.name: Mewtwo
forms.dexText: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

forms.name: Mew
forms.dexText: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

forms.name: Chikorita
forms.dexText: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

forms.name: Bayleef
forms.dexText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

forms.name: Meganium
forms.dexText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

forms.name: Cyndaquil
forms.dexText: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

forms.name: Quilava
forms.dexText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

forms.name: Typhlosion
forms.dexText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

forms.name: Totodile
forms.dexText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

forms.name: Croconaw
forms.dexText: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

forms.name: Feraligatr
forms.dexText: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

forms.name: Sentret
forms.dexText: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

forms.name: Furret
forms.dexText: There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting Rattata.

forms.name: Hoothoot
forms.dexText: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

forms.name: Noctowl
forms.dexText: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

forms.name: Ledyba
forms.dexText: When the weather turns cold, numerous Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

forms.name: Ledian
forms.dexText: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

forms.name: Spinarak
forms.dexText: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

forms.name: Ariados
forms.dexText: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.

forms.name: Crobat
forms.dexText: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

forms.name: Chinchou
forms.dexText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

forms.name: Lanturn
forms.dexText: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

forms.name: Pichu
forms.dexText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

forms.name: Cleffa
forms.dexText: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of Cleffa strangely increase.

forms.name: Igglybuff
forms.dexText: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.

forms.name: Togepi
forms.dexText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

forms.name: Togetic
forms.dexText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

forms.name: Natu
forms.dexText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

forms.name: Xatu
forms.dexText: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

forms.name: Mareep
forms.dexText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

forms.name: Flaaffy
forms.dexText: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

forms.name: Ampharos
forms.dexText: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

forms.name: Bellossom
forms.dexText: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

forms.name: Marill
forms.dexText: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

forms.name: Azumarill
forms.dexText: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

forms.name: Sudowoodo
forms.dexText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

forms.name: Politoed
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding King's Rock
forms.dexText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

forms.name: Hoppip
forms.dexText: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

forms.name: Skiploom
forms.dexText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

forms.name: Jumpluff
forms.dexText: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

forms.name: Aipom
forms.dexText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

forms.name: Sunkern
forms.dexText: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

forms.name: Sunflora
forms.dexText: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

forms.name: Yanma
forms.dexText: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

forms.name: Wooper
forms.dexText: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

forms.name: Quagsire
forms.dexText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

forms.name: Espeon
forms.dexText: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe's next move.

forms.name: Umbreon
forms.dexText: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

forms.name: Murkrow
forms.dexText: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

forms.name: Slowking
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding King's Rock
forms.dexText: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

forms.name: Misdreavus
forms.dexText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

forms.name: Unown
forms.dexText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

forms.name: Wobbuffet
forms.dexText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

forms.name: Girafarig
forms.dexText: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.

forms.name: Pineco
forms.dexText: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

forms.name: Forretress
forms.dexText: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

forms.name: Dunsparce
forms.dexText: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.

forms.name: Gligar
forms.dexText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

forms.name: Steelix
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding Metal Coat
forms.dexText: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

forms.name: Snubbull
forms.dexText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

forms.name: Granbull
forms.dexText: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its Bite is powerful.

forms.name: Qwilfish
forms.dexText: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

forms.name: Scizor
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding Metal Coat
forms.dexText: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

forms.name: Shuckle
forms.dexText: It stores Berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

forms.name: Heracross
forms.dexText: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

forms.name: Sneasel
forms.dexText: Vicious in nature, it drives Pidgey from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.

forms.name: Teddiursa
forms.dexText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

forms.name: Ursaring
forms.dexText: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

forms.name: Slugma
forms.dexText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

forms.name: Magcargo
forms.dexText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

forms.name: Swinub
forms.dexText: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

forms.name: Piloswine
forms.dexText: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

forms.name: Corsola
forms.dexText: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these Pokémon.

forms.name: Remoraid
forms.dexText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

forms.name: Octillery
forms.dexText: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow Octillery.

forms.name: Delibird
forms.dexText: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

forms.name: Mantine
forms.dexText: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

forms.name: Skarmory
forms.dexText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

forms.name: Houndour
forms.dexText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

forms.name: Houndoom
forms.dexText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

forms.name: Kingdra
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding Dragon Scale
forms.dexText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

forms.name: Phanpy
forms.dexText: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

forms.name: Donphan
forms.dexText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.

forms.name: Porygon2
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding Up-Grade
forms.dexText: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

forms.name: Stantler
forms.dexText: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

forms.name: Smeargle
forms.dexText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

forms.name: Tyrogue
forms.dexText: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

forms.name: Hitmontop
forms.dexText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

forms.name: Smoochum
forms.dexText: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

forms.name: Elekid
forms.dexText: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

forms.name: Magby
forms.dexText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

forms.name: Miltank
forms.dexText: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

forms.name: Blissey
forms.dexText: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick Pokémon, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.

forms.name: Raikou
forms.dexText: This Pokémon races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

forms.name: Entei
forms.dexText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

forms.name: Suicune
forms.dexText: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

forms.name: Larvitar
forms.dexText: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

forms.name: Pupitar
forms.dexText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

forms.name: Tyranitar
forms.dexText: It has an impudent nature. Having great strength, it can even change surrounding landforms.

forms.name: Lugia
forms.dexText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

forms.name: Ho-oh
forms.dexText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

forms.name: Celebi
forms.dexText: When Celebi disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

forms.name: Treecko
forms.dexText: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day's weather.

forms.name: Grovyle
forms.dexText: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.

forms.name: Sceptile
forms.dexText: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.

forms.name: Torchic
forms.dexText: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

forms.name: Combusken
forms.dexText: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

forms.name: Blaziken
forms.dexText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

forms.name: Mudkip
forms.dexText: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.

forms.name: Marshtomp
forms.dexText: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.

forms.name: Swampert
forms.dexText: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

forms.name: Poochyena
forms.dexText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

forms.name: Mightyena
forms.dexText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

forms.name: Zigzagoon
forms.dexText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.

forms.name: Linoone
forms.dexText: When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.

forms.name: Wurmple
forms.dexText: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.

forms.name: Silcoon
forms.dexText: It conserves its energy by moving as little as possible. It awaits evolution while drinking only a little rainwater.

forms.name: Beautifly
forms.dexText: Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.

forms.name: Cascoon
forms.dexText: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

forms.name: Dustox
forms.dexText: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.

forms.name: Lotad
forms.dexText: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

forms.name: Lombre
forms.dexText: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

forms.name: Ludicolo
forms.dexText: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

forms.name: Seedot
forms.dexText: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging Pidgey.

forms.name: Nuzleaf
forms.dexText: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

forms.name: Shiftry
forms.dexText: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

forms.name: Taillow
forms.dexText: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

forms.name: Swellow
forms.dexText: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

forms.name: Wingull
forms.dexText: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

forms.name: Pelipper
forms.dexText: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

forms.name: Ralts
forms.dexText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

forms.name: Kirlia
forms.dexText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

forms.name: Gardevoir
forms.dexText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

forms.name: Surskit
forms.dexText: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

forms.name: Masquerain
forms.dexText: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

forms.name: Shroomish
forms.dexText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

forms.name: Breloom
forms.dexText: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

forms.name: Slakoth
forms.dexText: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

forms.name: Vigoroth
forms.dexText: It is always hungry because it won't stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can't keep still.

forms.name: Slaking
forms.dexText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

forms.name: Nincada
forms.dexText: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

forms.name: Ninjask
forms.dexText: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

forms.name: Shedinja
forms.dexText: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

forms.name: Whismur
forms.dexText: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

forms.name: Loudred
forms.dexText: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.

forms.name: Exploud
forms.dexText: It emits a variety of sounds from the holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.

forms.name: Makuhita
forms.dexText: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

forms.name: Hariyama
forms.dexText: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

forms.name: Azurill
forms.dexText: It battles by flinging around its tail, which is bigger than its body. The tail is a flotation device in water.

forms.name: Nosepass
forms.dexText: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.

forms.name: Skitty
forms.dexText: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.

forms.name: Delcatty
forms.dexText: The favorite of trend-conscious female Trainer, they are used in competition for their style and fur.

forms.name: Sableye
forms.dexText: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

forms.name: Mawile
forms.dexText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

forms.name: Aron
forms.dexText: It eats iron to build its steel body. It is a pest that descends from mountains to eat bridges and train tracks.

forms.name: Lairon
forms.dexText: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

forms.name: Aggron
forms.dexText: It claims a large mountain as its sole territory. It mercilessly thrashes those that violate its space.

forms.name: Meditite
forms.dexText: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

forms.name: Medicham
forms.dexText: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance- like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

forms.name: Electrike
forms.dexText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

forms.name: Manectric
forms.dexText: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

forms.name: Plusle
forms.dexText: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.

forms.name: Minun
forms.dexText: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

forms.name: Volbeat
forms.dexText: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

forms.name: Illumise
forms.dexText: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.

forms.name: Roselia
forms.dexText: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

forms.name: Gulpin
forms.dexText: There is nothing its stomach can't digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

forms.name: Swalot
forms.dexText: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

forms.name: Carvanha
forms.dexText: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.

forms.name: Sharpedo
forms.dexText: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.

forms.name: Wailmer
forms.dexText: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

forms.name: Wailord
forms.dexText: It is among the largest of all Pokémon. It herds prey in a pack then swallows the massed prey in one gulp.

forms.name: Numel
forms.dexText: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

forms.name: Camerupt
forms.dexText: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

forms.name: Torkoal
forms.dexText: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.

forms.name: Spoink
forms.dexText: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing about. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

forms.name: Grumpig
forms.dexText: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.

forms.name: Spinda
forms.dexText: No two Spinda are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.

forms.name: Trapinch
forms.dexText: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

forms.name: Vibrava
forms.dexText: It generates ultrasonic waves by flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

forms.name: Flygon
forms.dexText: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

forms.name: Cacnea
forms.dexText: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

forms.name: Cacturne
forms.dexText: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert's heat.

forms.name: Swablu
forms.dexText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

forms.name: Altaria
forms.dexText: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is Altaria's humming.

forms.name: Zangoose
forms.dexText: If it comes across a Seviper, its fur bristles and it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its best weapon.

forms.name: Seviper
forms.dexText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

forms.name: Lunatone
forms.dexText: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar cycle. It brims with power when exposed to the light of the full moon.

forms.name: Solrock
forms.dexText: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

forms.name: Barboach
forms.dexText: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.

forms.name: Whiscash
forms.dexText: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything - if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

forms.name: Corphish
forms.dexText: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

forms.name: Crawdaunt
forms.dexText: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

forms.name: Baltoy
forms.dexText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

forms.name: Claydol
forms.dexText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

forms.name: Lileep
forms.dexText: It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.

forms.name: Cradily
forms.dexText: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.

forms.name: Anorith
forms.dexText: It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

forms.name: Armaldo
forms.dexText: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

forms.name: Feebas
forms.dexText: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.

forms.name: Milotic
forms.dexText: Milotic is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

forms.name: Castform
forms.dexText: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather.

forms.name: Kecleon
forms.dexText: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.

forms.name: Shuppet
forms.dexText: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

forms.name: Banette
forms.dexText: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

forms.name: Duskull
forms.dexText: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

forms.name: Dusclops
forms.dexText: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

forms.name: Tropius
forms.dexText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

forms.name: Chimecho
forms.dexText: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly uses its long tail to pluck nuts and berries, which it loves to eat.

forms.name: Absol
forms.dexText: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.

forms.name: Wynaut
forms.dexText: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

forms.name: Snorunt
forms.dexText: It is said that a home visited by a Snorunt will prosper. It can withstand cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

forms.name: Glalie
forms.dexText: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

forms.name: Spheal
forms.dexText: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

forms.name: Sealeo
forms.dexText: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning Spheal on its nose.

forms.name: Walrein
forms.dexText: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.

forms.name: Clamperl
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding DeepSeaTooth
Use Linking Cord while holding DeepSeaScale
forms.dexText: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

forms.name: Huntail
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding DeepSeaTooth
forms.dexText: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.

forms.name: Gorebyss
evo: Use Linking Cord while holding DeepSeaScale
forms.dexText: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

forms.name: Relicanth
forms.dexText: It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.

forms.name: Luvdisc
forms.dexText: During the spawning season, countless Ludvdisc congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

forms.name: Bagon
forms.dexText: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

forms.name: Shelgon
forms.dexText: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

forms.name: Salamence
forms.dexText: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

forms.name: Beldum
forms.dexText: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.

forms.name: Metang
forms.dexText: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won't leave a scratch.

forms.name: Metagross
forms.dexText: It is formed by two Metang fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

forms.name: Regirock
forms.dexText: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.

forms.name: Regice
forms.dexText: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.

forms.name: Registeel
forms.dexText: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.

forms.name: Latias
forms.dexText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

forms.name: Latios
forms.dexText: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.

forms.name: Kyogre
forms.dexText: This Pokémon is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.

forms.name: Groudon
forms.dexText: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

forms.name: Rayquaza
forms.dexText: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.

forms.name: Jirachi
forms.dexText: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.

forms.name: Deoxys
forms.dexText: This Deoxys has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.

Pound.desc: Pounds the foe with forelegs or tail.

Karate Chop.desc: A chopping attack with a high critical-hit ratio.

DoubleSlap.desc: Repeatedly slaps the foe 2 to 5 times.

Comet Punch.desc: Repeatedly punches the foe 2 to 5 times.

Mega Punch.desc: A strong punch thrown with incredible power.

Pay Day.desc: Throws coins at the foe. Money is recovered after.

Fire Punch.desc: A fiery punch that may burn the foe.

Ice Punch.desc: An icy punch that may freeze the foe.

ThunderPunch.desc: An electrified punch that may paralyze the foe.

Scratch.desc: Scratches the foe with sharp claws.

ViceGrip.desc: Grips the foe with large and powerful pincers.

Guillotine.desc: A powerful pincer attack that may cause fainting.

Razor Wind.desc: A 2-turn move that strikes the foe on the 2nd turn.

Swords Dance.desc: A fighting dance that sharply raises Attack.

Cut.desc: Cuts the foe with sharp scythes, claws, etc.

Gust.desc: Strikes the foe with a gust of wind whipped up by wings.

Wing Attack.desc: Strikes the foe with wings spread wide.

Whirlwind.desc: Blows away the foe with wind and ends the battle.

Fly.desc: Flies up on the first turn, then strikes the next turn.

Bind.desc: Binds and squeezes the foe for 2 to 5 turns.

Slam.desc: Slams the foe with a long tail, vine, etc.

Vine Whip.desc: Strikes the foe with slender, whiplike vines.

Stomp.desc: Stomps the enemy with a big foot. May cause flinching.

Double Kick.desc: A double-kicking attack that strikes the foe twice.

Mega Kick.desc: An extremely powerful kick with intense force.

Jump Kick.desc: A strong jumping kick. May miss and hurt the kicker.

Rolling Kick.desc: A fast kick delivered from a rapid spin.

Sand-Attack.desc: Reduces the foe's accuracy by hurling sand in its face.

Headbutt.desc: A ramming attack that may cause flinching.

Horn Attack.desc: Jabs the foe with sharp horns.

Fury Attack.desc: Jabs the foe 2 to 5 times with sharp horns, etc.

Horn Drill.desc: A one-hit KO attack that uses a horn like a drill.

Tackle.desc: Charges the foe with a full- body tackle.

Body Slam.desc: A full-body slam that may cause paralysis.

Wrap.desc: Wraps and squeezes the foe 2 to 5 times with vines, etc.

Take Down.desc: A reckless charge attack that also hurts the user.

Thrash.desc: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns that confuses the user.

Double-Edge.desc: A life-risking tackle that also hurts the user.

Tail Whip.desc: Wags the tail to lower the foe's Defense.

Poison Sting.desc: A toxic attack with barbs, etc., that may poison.

Twineedle.desc: Stingers on the forelegs jab the foe twice.

Pin Missile.desc: Sharp pins are fired to strike 2 to 5 times.

Leer.desc: Frightens the foe with a leer to lower Defense.

Bite.desc: Bites with vicious fangs. May cause flinching.

Growl.desc: Growls cutely to reduce the foe's Attack.

Roar.desc: Makes the foe flee to end the battle.

Sing.desc: A soothing song lulls the foe into a deep slumber.

Supersonic.desc: Emits bizarre sound waves that may confuse the foe.

SonicBoom.desc: Launches shock waves that always inflict 20 HP damage.

Disable.desc: Psychically disables one of the foe's moves.

Acid.desc: Sprays a hide-melting acid. May lower Defense.

Ember.desc: A weak fire attack that may inflict a burn.

Flamethrower.desc: A powerful fire attack that may inflict a burn.
